flight.name: Flight
flight.does: units can fly over anything, and can be built with wings

gate.name: Gate
gate.does: an army of up to 16 units can jump between two of your provinces through a gate

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.does: unlocks artillery APIs; unlocks paid artillery and longer-range bodies

scan.name: Scan
scan.does: unlocks scan APIs; unlocks paid scans and enhanced-vision bodies

cloak.name: Cloak
cloak.does: unlocks cloak APIs; unlocks paid cloaking and stealth bodies

stealth.name: Enhanced stealth
stealth.does: units can be built with stealth 2

airWeapons.name: Air weapons
airWeapons.does: winged units can be built with range 1

armor.name: Armor
armor.does: unlocks armor APIs; unlocks paid armor

antiAir.name: Anti-air
antiAir.does: unlocks antiAir APIs; unlocks ground targeting of flying bodies

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.does: unlocks pierce APIs; unlocks configurable armor penetration; lower raw damage and higher CPU per shot

faith.name: Faith
faith.does: lets your code found a faith and preach it in provinces you reach

turbines.name: Turbines
turbines.does: unlocks wind, hydro and tidal plants

storage.name: Storage
storage.does: unlocks batteries and a grid reserve

drilling.name: Drilling
drilling.does: unlocks geothermal plants on rift land

transmission.name: Transmission
transmission.does: power deals, and grids that cross allies' land

subseaCable.name: Subsea cable
subseaCable.does: grids cross researched sea routes without a ship on station

fission.name: Fission
fission.does: unlocks reactors: 10 MW a province, and a meltdown when one falls

fusion.name: Fusion
fusion.does: unlocks fusion plants of up to 30 MW

faiths.name: The Fellowship of the Null Byte

energy.wind: 0.62 + Σ amp × sin(k × lon + tilt × lat − speed × t + phase), held to 0..1.5; lon = atan2(z, x), lat = asin(y)

solar.does: rated MW × the sun's height; desert ×1.25, forest ×0.6, winter ×0.7

boiler.does: rated MW while it burns cargo from its town's depot, only when the island is short

wind.does: rated MW × the wind (0 to 1.5); coasts and mountain edges ×1.3, desert ×0.9, forest ×0.6

hydro.does: rated MW, steady; 1.5 MW a province for each mountain or lake beside it; winter ×0.7

tidal.does: rated MW × the tide (0.1 to 1, two a day); 1 MW a province for each stretch of ocean beside it

geo.does: rated MW, steady; rift land only, 4 MW a province

reactor.does: rated MW, steady; 10 MW a province; destroyed, it melts down and nobody mines there for 300 s

fusion.does: rated MW, steady, up to 30 MW a plant

battery.does: stores its capacity in MW·s and moves a sixtieth of it a second, for its own island

research.waiting: research on Scan saves toward its offer of 300000 cycles: 296041 saved so far. The research lane puts up to 4136 a second, as compute.cpu's research limit allows (with none, 25% of income) into savings, and an attempt runs once they hold the offer
